config.name: Notebook
config.description: Notes and prompts at hand: a tab at the screen edge (drag it up or down; a top-bar button on phones) opens a panel of cards. A tap outside closes the panel unless it is pinned; on a PC its bottom edge and corner resize it. Long notes show three lines and open on a tap; the sheets icon copies the text. Search, tags, add, edit, delete. Notes are kept on the Marinara server, so every device sees them.
